stories.title: Exclusive | New AI Czar Unveils Goals, Members of White House Task Force
stories.simple_summary: The White House has created a new task force to oversee AI and announced its goals and team members.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies and investors — the government is trying to set rules for AI, but nothing that directly affects your daily life right now.

stories.title: UCLA alumnus turns medical school frustrations into AI study app ‘Neural Consult’
stories.simple_summary: A doctor created an AI app called Neural Consult to help medical students study, based on problems he had in medical school.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a student or help students study, this is one tool that might help them learn — similar to having a tutor available through your phone.

stories.title: AI Deal Frenzy Powers Hong Kong Fundraising to Record Summer
stories.simple_summary: AI companies in Hong Kong are raising record amounts of money from investors this summer.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on as a small business owner.

stories.title: Trump taps Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as AI czar: WSJ reports
stories.simple_summary: The President is appointing Jay Clayton, an intelligence official, to oversee AI policy for the government.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about government leadership on AI — mainly relevant to those interested in policy, not something that changes your daily life immediately.

stories.title: AI giants not 'careful enough,' ex-OpenAI engineer warns
stories.simple_summary: A former engineer at OpenAI (a major AI company) says the big AI companies are not being careful enough about safety.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one person's warning about whether AI companies should be more cautious — it's ongoing debate among experts, not an emergency affecting you today.

stories.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs
stories.simple_summary: Amazon says it stopped using secret agreements (called NDAs) that prevented people from talking about data centers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about Amazon's business practices — not something affecting typical small business owners.

stories.title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
stories.simple_summary: The video game company Capcom is planning to use AI to help create games in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you work in video games, this doesn't affect you — it's one company's plan to change how they make games.

stories.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
stories.simple_summary: A safety employee quit OpenAI and said the company's culture has serious problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is internal drama at one company — it raises questions about whether AI companies are being responsible, but doesn't directly affect you as a customer or business owner.

stories.title: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Splice (a music tool company) thinks AI-written emails are making it harder for people to have real conversations.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one person's opinion that AI might be changing how we communicate — worth thinking about if you rely on email conversations with customers.

stories.title: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
stories.simple_summary: David Robinson, who used to check if OpenAI's AI was safe, quit his job and is publicly warning that the company has problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This raises concerns about whether one of the biggest AI companies is being responsible enough, but doesn't immediately change how AI affects you.

stories.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.simple_summary: There are now AI assistants you can use right in text messages — some general purpose, some made for families, travel, or work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use text messages, you may soon be able to ask an AI helper questions through texting, like having a digital assistant in your pocket.

stories.title: How AI helped bring an ancient tomb dating to before the Roman empire back to life
stories.simple_summary: Scientists used AI to help study and visualize an ancient tomb from before Roman times.
stories.why_it_matters: This is how AI helps archaeologists and historians — interesting for learning about the past, but not something that affects daily life for most people.
